title: Finalize living report state with procedure completion
description:
As an operator, I want a living optimization Report to publish a terminal revision when its Procedure completes, so that the Report lifecycle, current activity, and linked Task status agree.

Out of scope: automatic score mutations, schema changes, or changing approval authority.

Feature: Terminal living Report reconciliation

Scenario: Complete a portfolio procedure
Given a living Report is running with a linked Procedure Task
When the portfolio procedure reaches a successful terminal result
Then the Report publishes a final terminal revision
And its lifecycle status is complete rather than running
And its current activity and next checkpoint describe the terminal outcome
And the linked Task, Procedure, and Report states agree

Scenario: Fail final publication
Given the procedure result is otherwise terminal
When the final Report publication fails
Then the procedure fails closed
And the Report does not falsely claim completion

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Added failing outside-in coverage for successful and incomplete terminal revisions. The runner now decides and records terminal_status before publishing the final immutable revision, includes it in raw evidence, and emits terminal-specific current activity and next steps. Focused portfolio, living-report, and runtime suites pass: 310 tests.
